# slack-app_conversation (Resource)

Creates and manages a Slack public or private channel with `conversations.create`. Destroying the resource archives the channel. Existing channels can be imported by channel ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the public or private channel. Slack allows lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores, up to 80 characters.

### Optional

- `is_private` (Boolean) Whether to create a private channel. Defaults to false.
- `team_id` (String) The workspace ID, required when using an organization-level token.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
